captions.top: Shoulders, hips and knees in a line

steps.text: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your buttocks and lift your hips.
Stop when your shoulders, hips and knees are in a straight line.

safety: Do not arch your lower back.
Use a mat or a folded towel under you.

mistakes.label: low_hips
mistakes.wrong: your hips did not lift high enough
mistakes.right: Lift your hips a little higher, towards a straight line from shoulders to knees, without pain in your back.

mistakes.label: over_arch
mistakes.wrong: your hips went too high, so your lower back arched
mistakes.right: Do not push your hips too high; keep your lower back from arching.
